# Planning Poker for Jira

> Planning Poker for Jira Cloud: the team votes on work items in secret, all cards are revealed at once, and the agreed estimate is saved to the Story Points field or the original time estimate.

Planning Poker for Jira is a Jira Cloud app by Vudia, built on Atlassian Forge.
Atlassian Marketplace listing: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/36487747/planning-poker-for-jira-estimation-sprint-planning
Support: info@vudia.site

## Docs

- [Overview](https://docs.vudia.site/): Planning Poker for Jira Cloud: the team votes on work items in secret, all cards are revealed at once, and the agreed estimate is saved to the Story Points field or the original time estimate.
- [Game basics](https://docs.vudia.site/game-basics.html): Roles, card decks, estimation fields and the terms used in Planning Poker for Jira, to read before configuring your first game.
- [Create a game](https://docs.vudia.site/create-a-game.html): How to create a Planning Poker game in Jira: game settings, card deck, estimators, and choosing the work items to estimate by filter or JQL.
- [Game flow](https://docs.vudia.site/game-flow.html): How a Planning Poker round runs in Jira: secret voting, notes, the round timer, Suggest estimate, revealing votes, re-voting and saving the final estimate.
- [Manage games](https://docs.vudia.site/manage-games.html): The Games screen of Planning Poker for Jira: search and filters, cloning a game, copying its link, reports and CSV export.
- [Jira configuration](https://docs.vudia.site/jira-configuration.html): What Jira needs so Planning Poker can save estimates: the Story Points or original estimate field on the work item screen, and how to fix write errors.
- [FAQ](https://docs.vudia.site/faq.html): Answers to common questions about Planning Poker for Jira: finding the app, inviting the team, why someone cannot vote, the ∞ and ☕ cards, split votes, and where estimates are written in Jira.
- [Support](https://docs.vudia.site/support.html): How to get help with Planning Poker for Jira, report a problem or request a feature.
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.vudia.site/privacy.html): What Planning Poker for Jira reads and stores, where the data lives on Atlassian Forge, and what it never collects.
- [Security Policy](https://docs.vudia.site/security.html): How Planning Poker for Jira is built on Atlassian Forge, the permissions it uses, and how to report a security issue.
